notes: GET /workspaces/{wId}/templates returns clean HTTP 404 (not a Spring-MVC 'No static resource' 404, just upstream not-found). This confirms the workspace-level templates path does not exist. Clockify supports templates only at the project level via /workspaces/{wId}/projects/{pId}/templates. The delete path DELETE /workspaces/{wId}/templates/{templateId} is therefore also absent as a live endpoint.
